title: Chicken Jockey Plus
description: Adds commands to summon different variant jockeys
body:
Ive noticed there wasn't any way to spawn certain types of chicken jockys,
so I made this mod in one day for anyone with the same weird desire to spawn
whatever jocky you'd want.

Chicken Jockey Plus

A simple Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.8

✨ Features

Adds a custom command:

/summon_jockey <chicken_variant> [zombie_type]


Chicken Variants

warm 🐔

cold 🐔

temperate 🐔

Zombie Types (always babies)

zombie

husk

drowned

zombified_piglin

zombie_villager

If you only specify a chicken variant, it defaults to a baby zombie passenger.

If you add a zombie type, you can mix and match:

warm chicken + baby husk

cold chicken + baby drowned

temperate chicken + baby zombified piglin

and more!

📜 Example Commands

/summon_jockey warm → Warm chicken with a baby zombie

/summon_jockey cold husk → Cold chicken with a baby husk

/summon_jockey temperate zombie_villager → Temperate chicken with a baby zombie villager

🎯 Perfect For

Custom maps

Funny survival challenges

Expanding the variety of jockey mobs in Minecraft
